question: J, K, L, R, S and T live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 6. Only three people live between R and S, where R lives below S. J lives on an odd numbered floor and immediately above R. L lives on one of the floors below K and on one of the floors above T. Who lives on floor number 4?
solution:
Given: J, K, L, R, S and T live on six different floors of the same building.

The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 6.

Only three people live between R and S, where R lives below S.

J lives on an odd numbered floor and immediately above R.

L lives on one of the floors below K and on one of the floors above T.
